subject.title: fix(status): use legacy Codex OAuth profiles for OpenAI usage

question: Should OpenClaw runtime provider-usage auth read retired `openai-codex:*` profiles for canonical OpenAI usage, or should affected users run doctor migration first?
rationale: The branch is technically plausible and proven, but it changes the repository's stated compatibility boundary for retired provider ids.

options.title: Keep doctor-only migration
options.body: Close this PR and keep legacy `openai-codex:*` profile repair in `openclaw doctor --fix` unless a maintainer sponsors a runtime exception later.

options.title: Sponsor the usage-only bridge
options.body: Reopen or continue this PR with explicit maintainer acceptance that `status --usage` may read retired profile ids while reporting canonical `openai` usage.

options.title: Request a narrower compatibility plan
options.body: Ask for a follow-up that documents the temporary fallback, removal plan, and interaction with the synthetic app-server status route before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep doctor-only migration
recommendation.body: Close this PR and keep legacy `openai-codex:*` profile repair in `openclaw doctor --fix` unless a maintainer sponsors a runtime exception later.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the provider identity migration and has the strongest history on the canonical OpenAI/auth boundary.
